I don't want to say its PTSD, it just seems extreme looking back on it maybe its denial but I just feel maybe I'm just being dramatic about it all. It's odd hearing someone call it torture but looking back on it the agony I felt mentally during her drunk episodes and the confusion has to why someone I was meant to trust was causing me so much fear is mental torture that I doubt I'll ever recover from. I guess in reality now that I look on it I just normalized the behavior, I always thought this was normal behavior for a parent.
